observation.limitations: The declared 63-sample window is the prior alpha.2 review, not the newer cohort. Separate alpha.10 read-only profile aggregates on October 11 show Astra 3 selections across 18 conditional opportunities, summed expected selections 2.868. No Session IDs or sequence in aggregates. Bounded native metadata from the requested local Session shows five Sol turns followed by two Astra turns; the last has 178 steps under one frozen allocation. Tail scan is limited, not full history. Actual per-turn pool/weights are not durably retained. Two user-reported valid unknown classifier results are not a population unknown rate. No content, credentials or raw export uploaded.

previousReview: Prior allocation review #332/#333, post-delivery review #334, fixed-outcome diagnostics #398, budget/config trial #400, classifier disable #405 and published capability/diagnostic repair #407.
findings: Prior 63 decisions cannot attribute later incidents. Valid unknown is not a timeout. Projection regressions establish avoidable anchor loss/incidental-omission downgrade, not the actual task root cause. The reported Astra streak is two allocations, not 178 independent choices. Under an explicitly assumed two-model category pool, production Session/turn seeds reproduce both Astra choices at conditional shares 11.8% then 23.1%; this is conditional reproduction, not recovered decision evidence. A 20000-turn synthetic fixed-previous v1 scan yields 4563 Astra hits and 1014 adjacent pairs, showing runs are possible, not proving actual distribution conformity. No observed aggregate inflation is established. V1 intentionally grants marked continuity; the user now requests a stricter cost preference, not a statistically proven RNG repair.
decision: Issues #409/#410: preserve bounded task anchor/chain and separate incidental omission from task limitations; keep genuine unknown, account proof, reasoning off, no tools, one call/no retry, 128 output tokens and native admission. In the first fitting supplier category, v2 uses unmarked candidates whenever available; marked candidates remain a fallback only when that category has no fitting unmarked peer. Remove marked continuity bonus, retain ordinary 1.5 bonus and positive within-tier weights. Record bounded deferred count and keep v1 codecs/cohorts readable without relabeling. Fit is not proof peers can solve the task; no automatic escalation, retry, category weakening or in-turn switch. No new persistent population or measured accuracy/cost-saving claim.
validation: Projection and cost-tier regressions failed before implementation. Focused 121 tests and test typecheck pass, including 20000-seed scans per previous state, all-marked/ordinary positive distribution, deferred-only exclusion, legacy v1 decoding and persistent cohort preservation. Explicit missing-anchor tests retain conservative downshift protection. Native saved-mark/restart fixture now asserts cost tier rather than v1 shares. Full gate and exact alpha.11 pack/tarball verification remain required. No real model requests, credential access, profile edits or Desktop restart.

followUp.metric: Unknown among valid results versus blocked simple/routine by projection and producer; v2 selected/no-fit counts and within-tier conditional expected/actual selections separately from v1 and deferred candidates. Count new turns, not messages. Legacy absence is unknown. Labeled quality/outcomes remain required; no billing/latency inference.
followUp.action: Review anchor preservation and whether ordinary-tier choices pass independent task validation without underpowering complex work; review marked fallback only where actual fit evidence supports it. Retain genuine uncertainty. Do not infer solved/failed tasks from category or model ID. Defer further tuning without sufficient evidence; linked #334, no automatic upload or live benchmark.
